Cinemon

A fictive independant theater needing a new website for its queer folks.

This project is an exercise done during my formation at the Cepegra Center.

Main screens

Here are the screens created for the mobile version of the website

UI Kit

Here are the components I created for the project. You’ll find various icons illustrating the benefits of becoming member of the Cinemon theatre

Identity

The content of the pages was largely inspired by the Pink Screen 2024, and more precisely by the “Get animated” session at the Nova cinema in Brussels, the design being originaly created by Kidnap your Designer

Bricolage Grotesque is a variable open source typography designed by Mathieu Triay. “Grotesque” refers to the monstrous, and by extension, to the queerness. The term “Bricolage” (DIY) makes the link with mutual aid and spaces made with “the means at hand”

DINdong typographically degenders the characters. This is a font created by Clara Sambot and hosted on the “Bye Bye Binary” typography library

The logo has been created by Gregory Fichère, teacher at Cepegra Center (forem)

This portfolio

This portfolio uses the same fonts and almost the same colors, because I love them. There is no other explanation about this <3
